statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (((E X).filter (fun n => H X n=0)).card:ℝ) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 探索猜想：平方根步长窗口的漏点密度趋零
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: vanishing density of missed square-root-window targets

brief.zh: 这比正比例命中更强。尝试针对小素数区间建立均方误差，对照局部同余主项；仅有二阶矩上界尚不够。
brief.en: Try a mean-square approximation with a residue-sensitive main term for the short prime factor. A bounded second moment alone leaves exceptions.
